title: Simulations Schema
description: Defines simulation configuration, time evolution, modules, and coupling for the Resonance Substrate Model (RSM). Supports multi-layer substrate evolution, distributed agents, quantum triads, sensing, and operator-driven dynamics.

time.description: Controls temporal evolution of the simulation.

timestep.description: Duration of a single simulation step.

modules.description: List of simulation modules to activate (fields, operators, quantum, distributed, sensing, etc.).

initial_conditions.description: Initial state of fields, agents, and substrate layers.

spatial.description: Spatial configuration for the simulation domain.

quantum.description: Quantum Triad Model configuration (0D point-states, 1D spin-lines, 2D coherence sheets).

distributed.description: Distributed agent configuration for multi-agent substrate interaction.

sensing.description: List of sensing modules active during the simulation.

output.description: Controls what data is recorded during the simulation.

frequency.description: How often to record simulation state.

fields.description: Which fields or modules to record.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for documentation, provenance, or schema evolution.
